meta.description: Full end-to-end pipeline orchestrator. Resolves the client config ONCE from the Notion registry, then composes Module 1 -> (Module 2 || Module 3) -> Module 4 via Execute Workflow nodes, passing client_config through so sub-workflows skip their own lookup. Branches to a Telegram review alert when Module 1 flags the RFQ incomplete (no proposal is assembled). NOTE: after first deploy, repoint each 'Call Module N' Execute Workflow node to the deployed sub-workflow id (deploy_workflows.py --relink does this by name).

parameters.content:
## 00 — End-to-end orchestrator (thin composer)
**Load Client Registry → Map Client Config** resolves `client_config` ONCE and passes it through every module (resolve-once; sub-workflows skip their own Notion lookup).

**Call Module 1 → RFQ Complete?** branches: if Module 1 flags the RFQ `incomplete`, it sends **RFQ Needs Review** (Telegram) and stops — no proposal is assembled (delivers the website's Module-1 promise). If complete, **Module 2 ∥ Module 3** run in parallel, merge, then **Module 4** assembles.

⚠️ After first deploy, repoint each **Call Module N** node to the deployed sub-workflow id — `scripts/deploy_workflows.py --relink` maps them by name automatically.

Pricing inputs are entered manually (**Prep Pricing Input**) — phase 1 has no auto hours-estimation engine (explicit non-goal).
